subject: Business Models
title: Platform Leakage
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Platform Leakage.

hook.text: Craigslist lost its jobs section to Indeed, housing to Zillow, and dating to Tinder. Death by 1,000 cuts.

buildup.text: Platform leakage is when specialized competitors peel off individual verticals from a general platform.

discovery.text: Each vertical competitor offers a better experience: better search, curation, and community for that niche.

twist.text: Craigslist still exists and is still profitable. Its simplicity is both its weakness and its survival tool.

climax.text: Horizontal platforms are vulnerable to vertical specialists. Breadth invites unbundling.

punchline.text: Do everything okay, or one thing great. Specialists always attack.
